title: 促销带来销售增长，怎样汇报活动结果？
topic: 用活动目标、优惠方式和销售数据说明促销效果

source.title: Amazon Prime Day 2021: A small business success story
source.section: Amazon Prime Day 2021: A small business success story
source.context: Amazon 官方 Prime Day 商家促销回顾：活动目标、优惠机制与销售结果。
paragraphs: A key goal for Prime Day 2021 was helping Amazon's small business selling partners connect with new customers and grow their sales. As part of a new $100 million investment to help small business sellers succeed, Amazon funded a Spend $10, get $10 promotion in the days leading up to Prime Day.

With the promo, Prime members received a $10 credit to spend on Prime Day when they spent $10 on small business products offered by more than 300,000 sellers in Amazon's store during the two-week lead-up to Prime Day—from June 7 to 20.

In the first twenty-four hours of the promotion, more than 2.5 million customers bought products from small businesses. After the full two week period, customers had spent over $1.9 billion on more than 70 million items, which was more than a 100% year-over-year increase on sales compared to the Prime Day 2020 promotion in October.
translations: Prime Day 2021 的一个重要目标，是帮助 Amazon 的小企业卖家接触新客户并提高销售额。作为一项总额 1 亿美元、旨在帮助小企业卖家发展的新投资的一部分，Amazon 为 Prime Day 前推出的“消费 10 美元，获得 10 美元”活动提供了资金支持。
在这项促销中，Prime 会员购买 Amazon 商店内超过 30 万家卖家提供的小企业商品时，先消费 10 美元，就能获得 10 美元额度用于 Prime Day 购物。促销持续两周，从 6 月 7 日到 20 日。
促销开始后的前 24 小时内，超过 250 万名顾客购买了小企业商品。两周活动结束后，顾客购买了超过 7,000 万件商品，总消费超过 19 亿美元；与 2020 年 10 月的 Prime Day 促销相比，销售额同比增长超过 100%。
fullTextParagraphs: Amazon highlighted small businesses for Prime Day 2021, and third-party selling partners had record-breaking sales.

A key goal for Prime Day 2021 was helping Amazon's small business selling partners connect with new customers and grow their sales. As part of a new $100 million investment to help small business sellers succeed, Amazon funded a Spend $10, get $10 promotion in the days leading up to Prime Day.

With the promo, Prime members received a $10 credit to spend on Prime Day when they spent $10 on small business products offered by more than 300,000 sellers in Amazon's store during the two-week lead-up to Prime Day—from June 7 to 20.

In the first twenty-four hours of the promotion, more than 2.5 million customers bought products from small businesses. After the full two week period, customers had spent over $1.9 billion on more than 70 million items, which was more than a 100% year-over-year increase on sales compared to the Prime Day 2020 promotion in October.
Small businesses from all 50 states participated in the lead-up promotion, with Delaware, Wyoming, and California seeing the highest sales of small business products per capita.

The momentum continued for Amazon’s selling partners—almost all of whom are small and medium businesses—during Prime Day, June 21-22. The sales event was the biggest two-day period ever for Amazon’s third-party sellers, growing even more than Amazon’s retail business.

On Amazon Live, celebrities Kristen Bell, Karamo Brown, and Mindy Kaling interviewed small business owners from companies such as Pawstruck, a dog treat company, and Kanda Chocolates, during the small business promotion.

During Prime Day, Amazon Live’s Small Business Showcase enabled customers to interact directly with small business owners and search for hundreds of thousands of Prime Day deals from selling partners, includes everything from fitness products to candles.

Amazon’s partnership with third-party selling partners continues to be a win-win for small businesses and customers. Sellers help us provide customers with vast product selection and great prices, and we help sellers reach hundreds of millions of customers, grow sales, and build their brands. Selling partners account for approximately 60% of physical product sales in our store.
We depend on them to provide a great customer experience, which is why we invested $18 billion last year to help fuel their success.

“We sold 69% more units on the first day of Prime Day than we did on the same day the previous year. We have been able to reach thousands of new customers through Amazon that we would not have been able to reach otherwise,” said Contreras.

“This year’s Prime Day surpassed all of our expectations. Our products were listed on a Lighting Deal, and we saw an over 750% increase in units sold, resulting in a record sales day for us,” said Bairstow. “As a small business, Prime Day has become one of the most important events of the year, not only for its sales boost, but also for raising awareness with new customers.”

“We love our partnership with Amazon. This was our first participation in Prime Day, and we saw around a 400% increase of new customers on our storefront,” said the Walker brothers. “For a business like ours, connecting with new customers is important, and it wouldn’t have been possible without Amazon’s consistent efforts to promote us.”

“We are thrilled to be working with Amazon; Prime Day is a resounding success for our small business. We appreciate that Amazon is a partner who can help us succeed, and makes it simple for customers to find and purchase Mother’s Shea. Amazon enables us to reach an audience that would otherwise be difficult to reach on our own.” said, Akuete.

“Prime Day 2021 has been fantastic for small businesses like us; it was by far one of our best sales days in the company's history. In addition, even before Prime Day, my business saw 15% sales increase on Amazon thanks to the Spend $10, get $10 promotion. The increase in sales will definitely help support operations as we prepare for the rest of the year,” said Goguen.

scenario.title: 复盘一场帮助小企业吸引新客的促销
english: The campaign aimed to help small sellers reach new customers.
Amazon funded a $10 credit offer for qualifying purchases.
Report the campaign results with the time period and comparison.
chinese: 这场活动的目标是帮助小企业卖家接触新客户。
Amazon 为符合条件的购买提供 10 美元额度。
请说明统计周期和对比结果，汇报活动成效。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请向团队汇报 Amazon Prime Day 小企业促销：说明活动目标、优惠方式，以及前 24 小时和两周后的结果。
firstAttempt.sample: The campaign aimed to help small-business sellers reach new customers. Amazon funded a “Spend $10, Get $10” offer: Prime members received a $10 credit after spending $10 on eligible small-business products. In the first 24 hours, more than 2.5 million customers bought from small businesses. Over the two-week promotion, customers spent more than $1.9 billion on over 70 million items. Sales were up more than 100% year over year compared with the October 2020 Prime Day promotion.
firstAttempt.rationale: 把前 24 小时和两周数据分开汇报，避免混淆统计周期。

rewrite.pattern: The campaign aimed to [goal]. In [time period], [metric]. Compared with [baseline], [result].

cloze.prompt: The campaign aimed to help sellers reach new ______.
cloze.why: reach new customers 是“接触新客户”。

cloze.prompt: In the first 24 hours, more than 2.5 million customers ______ from small businesses.
cloze.why: 用 bought 说明前 24 小时内发生的购买行为。

cloze.prompt: Sales were up over 100% year over ______.
cloze.why: year over year 表示同比。

choice.prompt: 老板问促销效果如何。哪种汇报给出的信息最有用？
options: The promotion aimed to attract new customers. More than 2.5 million customers bought from small businesses in the first 24 hours, and sales over two weeks were up more than 100% year over year.
We offered a discount and posted it online.
choice.why: 这条回答包含目标、统计周期和可比较的结果。

output.prompt: 你负责的两周促销目标是吸引新客户。活动期间有 8 万名新客户下单，销售额比去年同期高 18%。请用英文向经理汇报结果。
